about.s1_body: A professional catsitter, cat rescuer and feline behaviour enthusiast. Over twelve years I've helped rescue, treat and rehome more than 5,000 cats.
about.s2_body: Senior cats, kittens, shy or fearful cats, post-op and medication — I always use low-stress, respectful handling and adapt to each cat's personality.
about.s3_body: Every visit I check appetite, litter box and wellbeing — small changes matter. You'll get plenty of photos, videos and updates. And yes, I'll water your plants too. 🪴
about.s4_body: I also offer feline behaviour consultations — scratching, litter box troubles, introductions between cats, or simply understanding your cat better. Let's figure it out together.
about.s5_body: Rabbits, guinea pigs, birds, snakes, lizards — I love getting to know every species and follow your care instructions closely so their routine stays the same.
about.s6_body: And yes, I also offer dog walks! I've had dogs my whole life and walk dogs of all sizes and personalities, with care for safety and leash manners. I hope to become a lasting friend to your best friend. 🖤

reviews.verified_reviews_from_cat_owners: Verified reviews from cat owners in __CITY_NAME__
reviews.i_couldn_t_have_asked: "I couldn't have asked for a better cat sitter! Ligia took care of my baby as if it were her own, showing so much love, patience, and attention. She was incredibly attentive to my cat's needs and made sure Jazzy felt comfortable and safe. I received regular updates and could tell my cat was happy and relaxed. I highly recommend Ligia to anyone looking for a trustworthy, caring, and professional pet sitter."
reviews.she_is_a_great_sitter: "She is a great sitter who makes sure your cats are well taken care of. She sends pics/videos every visit and even though one of my cats is VERY shy, she was able to pet and bond with them a little. If you need an experienced and kind sitter, I would for sure recommend her!"
reviews.l_gia_was_great_with: "Lígia was great with my dog. She was very friendly, easy to communicate with, and always responsive. She took good care of her, spent time playing with her, and kept me updated with photos. It was so clear she gives real attention and care. I would happily book her again and definitely recommend her."
